notes:
Summary: Opaline Helpdesk is an AI-first helpdesk vendor powering customer portals for ~120 enterprise customers. They want to replace an expensive hybrid retrieval+cross-encoder stack that currently runs reranker for top-10 candidates with 200-300ms per-query tail latency. Primary goals: 1) ticket deflection (high-precision top-5 results), 2) strict latency SLOs for webchat (target <=120ms E2E for search+rerank), 3) predictable cost per ticket (budgeting for scale: millions of queries/month).

What they told us: "We will trade a small drop in top-10 recall for consistent sub-120ms responses to users; top-5 quality must be near-parity with our current cross-encoder". They emphasized index scale: 8-12M unique docs (KB articles, past tickets, attachments), incremental daily ingestion ~50-100k docs.

POC acceptance criteria (agreed): precision@5 >= 0.86 on sampled ticket deflection set; median latency < 60ms, 95th < 120ms at 1k QPS sim; cost-per-query modeling that shows <=40% reduction vs current infra when using Redwood batching + KV caching.

Tech constraints: embedding dim target 1536, prefer quantized model variants for cost. They asked about reranker options: Redwood lightweight re-ranker (distil cross-encoder) vs cloud cross-encoder fallback; require fallback routing if dedicated capacity saturated.

Security/ops notes: VPC-only control plane for production, SOC2 mandatory, SSO/SAML integration, KMS for key material, audit log retention 1 year. Data residency: US-only for now.

Next steps captured: (1) Redwood to run 10M ingest and index throughput test (estimated 8-10 hours), (2) schedule live POC perf day with Opaline SRE and their synthetic QPS harness (week of 2026-03-08), (3) deliver cost model by 2026-03-14, (4) security checklist response by 2026-03-20.
